fileDescription: Strings for Tilt Shift (Mouse Follow) v2.

myfx_tiltshiftmousefollowv2.name: Tilt Shift (Mouse Follow) v2
myfx_tiltshiftmousefollowv2.description: Stable v2. Band / ellipse / radial focus that follows the mouse (set params from events). New ID avoids breaking old projects.

mouseX.name: Mouse X (layout px)
mouseX.desc: Set every tick from Mouse.X (layout coordinates).

mouseY.name: Mouse Y (layout px)
mouseY.desc: Set every tick from Mouse.Y (layout coordinates).

angleDeg.name: Focus angle (deg)
angleDeg.desc: Band direction. 0=horizontal band (blur vs Y), 90=vertical band (blur vs X).

focusSize.name: Focus size (px)
focusSize.desc: Sharp region size. For ellipse, this is the Y radius; X radius = focusSize * Ellipse aspect.

transitionSize.name: Transition (px)
transitionSize.desc: Distance over which blur ramps up outside focus area.

blurRadius.name: Blur radius (px)
blurRadius.desc: Maximum blur sampling radius in pixels.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: 0% = tilt-shift band, 50% = ellipse focus, 100% = radial focus.

ellipseAspect.name: Ellipse aspect (X multiplier)
ellipseAspect.desc: Only used near Mode=50%. X radius multiplier for ellipse. 1=same as Y, 2=twice as wide.
